text:
harper: Quick brain dump after the design review. proposing a compact left rail that groups Models + Deployments + Jobs under one parent called 'Model Workspace'. adds a tiny quicknav (Recent • Starred • All). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder-compact-workspace :sparkles:
leo: love the quicknav for power users. question: how will deep links work for bookmarks and alerts? we need a stable, pasteable URL pattern.
mina: my proposal: canonical resource paths for everything important, e.g. `/orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId`, `/orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId/deployments/:depId`, and `/orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId/deployments/:depId/runs/:runId`. use hash or query only for ephemeral UI state like opened drawers.
gui: UX concern: collapsing Deployments into a parent may hide frequent actions. recommend adding a persistent 'Jump: Deployments' pill in the quicknav for orgs with >5 deployments. also show counts next to items.
harper: agreed. quicknav should be configurable per org and show counts. also propose collapsed breadcrumbs when >4 segments with an ellipsis; tooltip shows full path. copyable permalink icon always copies canonical path.
a11y-checker: accessibility notes: collapsed breadcrumb must expose the full path via aria-label; collapsed visual ellipsis cannot be the only way to access content. keyboard must be able to expand the crumb list and focus the individual crumb links. ensure contrast for active sidebar item >= 4.5:1.
leo: routing detail: server will keep redirects from legacy routes to new canonical for 12 months, plus client-side mapping for another 6 months. ops wants telemetry to decide extension.
ops-bot: staging deploy queued 2026-07-08T05:00:00Z. preview URL will be posted when ready. :rocket:
mina: test plan: add e2e that visits `/orgs/x/projects/y/models/123/deployments/456` and asserts the sidebar highlights Model Workspace, the Deployments pill is visible, and the H1 has focus. also keyboard-only test to tab into quicknav and activate Recent.
gui: copy microcopy: nav label "Deployments" with secondary microcopy "(runs/jobs)" when expanded seems like a good compromise for mixed audiences.
harper: i'll update the figma, add the accessibility checklist, and open an RFC with the routing helpers (paths.ts) and a legacy->new mapping table. scheduling a 20-min sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to walk devs through the mapping.
leo: happy to join.
a11y-checker: add a screenreader test that verifies collapsed crumb aria-label reads the full path and that focus lands on the main heading when opening deep links.
harper: thanks everyone — will follow up with the PR and attach telemetry queries for legacy hits. :thumbsup:
